information.en: Deep-learning QSM (iQSM+) and R2* (DeepRelaxo) reconstruction from multi-echo GRE magnitude/phase images.

regulatory_information.manufacturer_address: Kookaburra Circuit Lot 1, New Lambton Heights, NSW, AU, 2305
regulatory_information.safety_advices: Research use only. Not for diagnostic use.
regulatory_information.special_operating_instructions: Requires a multi-echo GRE acquisition with magnitude and phase image output.

information.en: Define the config to be executed by MRD server
Custom config file not listed in drop-down menu

Brain-masked (default): skull-stripped QSM/R2* (via FSL's BET2, suppressing non-brain background artifacts). Whole-head: unmasked QSM/R2* covering the full field of view. Applies to both QSM and R2* below, whichever is enabled.
Run iQSM+ deep-learning QSM reconstruction. On by default.

Also run DeepRelaxo's deep-learning R2* mapping from the same multi-echo GRE magnitude images. Off by default -- it takes noticeably longer than QSM alone; enable via retro-recon afterward if needed. Requires at least 2 echoes -- automatically skipped for single-echo acquisitions even if enabled.
